title: Gravitational Wave Energy Attenuation in Active Gravitational Fields
content: This paper investigates the propagation of gravitational waves through regions of  spacetime influenced by strong gravitational fields. We reformulate the wave energy  expression in terms of affine length, exploring how metric perturbations and the associated  energy densities deform proper geodesics. A central claim is proposed: gravitational waves  experience an energy drop when traversing regions where the spacetime is expressed  predominantly in affine terms. This claim is developed through variational analysis of the  metric and its impact on wave amplitude.
